author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn how to build a complete Backroom style horror game in Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints only. This step-by-step tutorial guides you from a blank project to a fully playable game including enemy AI, body cam camera style, jump scares, UI, puzzles and a complete environment!
You will learn about blueprint interface, level optimization, and also building a package of your game for Windows.

Course from @DevEdgeStudio
